key_claims: Tadej Pogacar is only the second rider in history to win a Tour de France and two monuments in the same season
Pogacar won four of five stage races he entered in 2021 and had 13 stage wins total
Pogacar is 23 years old and has fundamentally changed the pro cycling recruitment model to resemble professional soccer
Primož Roglič won the Vuelta España for a record-equaling third successive edition and is only the third rider to win a grand tour and Olympic gold in the same season
Wout van Aert won stage races across multiple categories: time trials, climbing stages, bunch sprints, and Ardennes classics in 2021
specific_numbers: Second place finish at Tirreno-Adriatico (van Aert)
Silver medal in world time trial championships (van Aert)
Silver medal in Olympic road race (van Aert)
cluster_reasoning: This is a pro cycling retrospective covering 2021's top riders (Pogacar, Roglič, van Aert), their achievements, and the evolution of pro cycling recruitment — pure cycling culture and history content with no training methodology, nutrition, or recovery focus.
